_comment: The voices graph's SUB-GRAPHS, declared from within (bean `rkqp`, owner 2026-09-30: "vendors/<id>/ should be declared subgraphs along with vendors/"; the #980 ruling that nesting is sanctioned only when a node inside the outer directory labels what it holds). Same shape as `beans/beans.json` and `docs/docs.json`: ContentDirectory entries, paths relative to THIS file's directory. The voices sitting directly here (`<id>/voice.json`) are the graph itself and are not listed; only sub-graphs are.
name: cat-harness

directories.description: Vendor voices: the base `agent-skill-authoring` voice specialised for one agent vendor each. Each vendor is its own sub-graph, declared by `vendors/vendors.json`.
